regime_read: The pack shows broad affiliation-based clustering across megacap tech (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META) with unusually heavy congressional and insider footprint, but few clusters cohere into multi-channel, non-extended actionable reads. The strongest alignment is in MSFT (lobbying, GitHub, HF-model, app-demand, patents, plus Altman/Ackman affiliations), with MU showing the highest momentum but near extension territory.
regime_read_zh: 证据包显示大型科技股（MSFT、NVDA、GOOGL、META）存在广泛的关联性聚类，且国会与内部人持仓痕迹异常集中，但真正形成多渠道、非超买可操作判读的聚类很少。最强对齐出现在 MSFT（游说、GitHub、HF 模型、应用需求、专利，叠加 Altman/Ackman 关联），MU 动能最强但已接近超买区。

theses.thesis: Six independent channels align on MSFT — lobbying at $3.65M, app demand (4.77 rating, 20M reviews), GitHub momentum, HF-model downloads at 33.7M/30d, patent cluster of 318, plus affiliation with Sam Altman [actor:Sam Altman, PARTNERS_WITH] and Bill Ackman [actor:Bill Ackman, AFFILIATES_WITH]. The convergence score of 6 with 2.25 weighted score and rs_vs_spy_60d of only +9.8pp means the name is not chased, unlike nearly every peer in the pack.
theses.thesis_zh: 六个独立渠道在 MSFT 上对齐 — 游说支出 $3.65M、应用需求（4.77 分、2000 万评论）、GitHub 动能、HF 模型 30 天下载量 3370 万、318 项专利集群，以及与 Sam Altman [actor:Sam Altman, PARTNERS_WITH] 和 Bill Ackman [actor:Bill Ackman, AFFILIATES_WITH] 的关联。收敛分 6、加权分 2.25，且 60 日相对 SPY 超额仅 +9.8pp，意味着该标的不像组合中几乎所有同行那样已被追逐。
second_order: GitHub ecosystem names benefiting from MSFT developer-platform traffic
OpenAI-adjacent infrastructure via Altman partnership channel
Enterprise software peers that co-sell with MSFT cloud stack
theses.dissent: Lobbying and app demand are slow-moving and could reflect legacy franchise strength rather than new catalyst; the Altman and Ackman ties are qualitative affiliations, not confirmed transactions.

falsifier.text: MSFT 60-day relative return vs SPY rises above +35pp without a corresponding step-up in HF-model momentum or patent activity.

theses.thesis: NVDA clusters on six channels (affiliation, analyst upgrades at 0.98 bull ratio, GitHub momentum, patents, retail buzz, special situation with earnings Aug 26) and carries the single most explicit political-influence footprint in the pack — Pelosi [actor:Nancy Pelosi, HOLDS_STAKE], MTG [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene, HOLDS_STAKE], McCaul [actor:Michael McCaul, HOLDS_STAKE], plus Cramer TALKS_ABOUT. But the earnings event in 8 days is a binary catalyst, and the whole AI complex is already consensus; rs_vs_spy_60d of -3.7pp means no chase risk but also no independent edge beyond the political overlay.
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA 在六个渠道上聚类（关联、分析师上调看多比 0.98、GitHub 动能、专利、零售热度、8 月 26 日财报特殊事件），且带有本包中最明确的政治影响力足迹 — Pelosi [actor:Nancy Pelosi, HOLDS_STAKE]、MTG [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene, HOLDS_STAKE]、McCaul [actor:Michael McCaul, HOLDS_STAKE]，以及 Cramer 的 TALKS_ABOUT。但 8 天后的财报是二元催化剂，整个 AI 板块已是共识；60 日相对 SPY -3.7pp 表明无追高风险，但除了政治叠加外也没有独立优势。
second_order: Chip-equipment and HBM suppliers keyed to NVDA's earnings call trajectory
AI-datacenter power names if NVDA guide confirms capex continuation
TSM, AMD, MU as correlated-basket reads on the AI supply-chain
theses.dissent: A single disappointment on the Aug 26 earnings call can unwind the political-positioning premium immediately; the congressional holdings may be long-standing rather than fresh accumulations.

falsifier.text: NVDA earnings on 2026-08-26 fails to print a 10% surprise, and analyst bull ratio drops below 0.7 within two weeks.

theses.thesis: MU shows the highest relative strength in the pack (rs_vs_spy_60d +33.7pp) with five channels firing: analyst upgrades (1.0 bull ratio), insider mspr at 100, patents at 288, StockTwits bull ratio 1.0 across 213K watchers, plus a Ro Khanna affiliation [actor:Ro Khanna, AFFILIATES_WITH, DISCLOSED]. Gov grant acceleration of 3.81 compounds the read. But the +33.7pp print is within 2pp of the extended threshold — a chase has already begun, so this is a watch-first name.
theses.thesis_zh: MU 在本包中相对强度最高（60 日相对 SPY +33.7pp），五个渠道发力：分析师上调（看多比 1.0）、内部人 mspr 100、288 项专利、StockTwits 看多比 1.0 且 21.3 万关注者，加上 Ro Khanna 关联 [actor:Ro Khanna, AFFILIATES_WITH, DISCLOSED]。政府拨款加速 3.81 进一步强化判读。但 +33.7pp 距超买阈值仅 2pp — 追逐已经开始，因此该名为观察优先。
second_order: Memory-controller and HBM test/assembly names that lag MU's move
Storage and server OEMs with MU exposure on the bill-of-materials
theses.dissent: The near-extension print means the informational edge may already be in the price; insider mspr at 100 could be small-sample or stale filings rather than fresh accumulation.

falsifier.text: MU 60-day relative return vs SPY crosses +35pp, or the gov grant acceleration falls below 1.0 in the next filing check.

theses.thesis: GOOGL aligns four channels — affiliation (Pelosi and Paul Pelosi [actor:Nancy Pelosi, HOLDS_STAKE], [actor:Paul Pelosi, AFFILIATES_WITH]), lobbying at $4.81M, analyst upgrades (0.73 bull ratio), and app demand (4.71 rating, 26M reviews) — but the name trades at rs_vs_spy_60d of -16pp, a relative-laggard hangover. The congressional footprint ($248.5M position across the cluster) plus the $4.81M lobbying spend suggest a policy-linked re-rating candidate, but the pack gives no catalyst date to pin this to.
theses.thesis_zh: GOOGL 对齐四个渠道 — 关联（Pelosi 与 Paul Pelosi [actor:Nancy Pelosi, HOLDS_STAKE], [actor:Paul Pelosi, AFFILIATES_WITH]）、游说支出 $4.81M、分析师上调（看多比 0.73）、应用需求（4.71 分、2600 万评论）— 但该股 60 日相对 SPY 为 -16pp，处于相对落后状态。国会持仓足迹（集群内 $2.485 亿）叠加 $4.81M 游说支出，暗示存在政策驱动的重估候选，但本包未给出可锚定的催化剂日期。
second_order: Cloud-competitor MSFT benefits if GOOGL's app-demand softness stems from AI-share shifts
Digital-ad names exposed to the same app-store demand channel
theses.dissent: The -16pp relative lag may reflect a genuine competitive or regulatory discount, not just a buying opportunity; the Pelosi holdings are not fresh filings in this pack.

falsifier.text: GOOGL analyst bull ratio falls below 0.6 and app reviews momentum turns negative over a 30-day window.

second_order: AI-infrastructure names that benefit from META's open-source LLM tooling (GitHub channel)
Online-ad peers keyed to META's app-store demand trends
theses.dissent: The strongest lobbying print in the pack also correlates with the heaviest regulatory risk; the GitHub and HF-model signals may reflect open-source presence rather than monetizable demand.

theses.thesis: INTC clusters on four channels — analyst upgrades (1.0 bull ratio), gov grant acceleration (0.14), patents at 357 — but is the pack's worst 60-day laggard at -17.5pp vs SPY, with no affiliation channel, no insider cluster, and no retail buzz beyond 40 WSB mentions. The analyst-bull ratio of 1.0 looks like a crowded-contra indicator on a name the broader family of signals is not confirming.
theses.thesis_zh: INTC 在四个渠道上聚类 — 分析师上调（看多比 1.0）、政府拨款加速（0.14）、357 项专利 — 但它是本包中 60 日最大落后股（相对 SPY -17.5pp），没有关联渠道、没有内部人集群、除 40 条 WSB 提及外没有零售热度。1.0 的分析师看多比更像是拥挤的反向指标，而更广泛的信号族并未确认。
theses.dissent: The gov grant channel (0.14 accel) is a clean contrarian cue if the analyst upgrade cluster turns out to be prescient; INTC could be a multi-quarter laggard-to-leader repricing.

falsifier.text: INTC gov grant acceleration rises above 1.0 and analyst bull ratio holds at 1.0 for two consecutive check cycles.

theses.thesis: RSG has a large insider cluster (14 buyers, $186.1M net) but the trump-linked channel prints SELL [trump_side: sell], and convergence score is only 2 with no affiliation, no political-actor footprint, and no scorable rs_vs_spy_60d. The insider buying and the trump-sell signal are pointing opposite directions, so the read does not cohere.
theses.thesis_zh: RSG 有大型内部人集群（14 位买家、净额 $1.861 亿），但特朗普关联渠道印出卖出 [trump_side: sell]，且收敛分仅 2，无关联、无政治人物足迹、无可评分的 60 日相对 SPY。内部人买入与特朗普卖出信号指向相反，判读无法自洽。
theses.dissent: The 14-buyer insider cluster at $186M is a large and unusually broad internal-conviction print; if the trump-sell flag is noise rather than signal, RSG could be a hidden accumulation read.

falsifier.text: RSG insider net usd drops below $50M on a 90-day rolling basis, or trump_side flips to buy on the next check.
